programmes.d: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

When Donnie decides that he wants to take his 1968 Fastback to SEMA, Dan and FantomWorks are thrown for a loop. Now, they need to get the Fastback and a 1964 Corvette to the prestigious show within a crushing time frame.

At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.
Værterne undersøger, hvad det koster at eje en motorcykel, og om den første MC skal være ny eller brugt.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1963 corvette and a 1931 Model A hot rod. The corvette has to be ready in time for a wedding in less than two months. The hot rod has been torn to pieces by a well-intentioned internet mechanic.
A step-by-step guide to buying a first motorcycle, covering sourcing, pricing, and key checks.

FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.

Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

When the 1941 Buick Coupe rolls into FantomWorks, it is the worst possible combination: a very difficult car and very demanding owner. Janelle wants her KZ-750 transformed into a cool stripped down ‘café’ bike – a challenge for FantomWorks new bike shop.
A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

The black 1978 Trans Am has a brand new motor and its ready to be fired up for the first time. The Malicious Intent, a 1969 Mustang is ready for the paint shop. The 1972 Corvette. Ugly to beautiful restoration is in the stripping process.

Sean asks Dan to find a 1969 Camaro that can be built into the custom restomod of his dreams. Jeff wants to give his 1969 Cutlass a rare Hurst makeover, but the engine has never run and there are more parts in boxes than on the car.

Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.
Værterne dykker ned i motorcykeludstyr, sikkerhed og det vigtigste gear til livet på to hjul.
The Mustang fights back! Unexpected breakdowns push the team to their limits in this brutal build session.

Nick bought his wife Danielle a 1953 Chevy Pickup for her 28th birthday. The couple wants a perfect FantomWorks restoration. The truck has other ideas. Eric’s rare 1939 LaSalle is a sight to behold, but it hasn’t seen a wrench in eighty years.
FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.
We drop $3K in mods on our $3K Mustang — will the upgrades finally make it worth the build?
Suspension upgrades are installed and tested to measure real-world handling gains.
Motorcycle engine types are explained, covering configurations and how they operate.
Tensions mount in Cayuga as a frightening crash occurs on the drag strip moments before Chris is set to perform his incredibly dangerous first night race of the season.

Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

The owner of a C10 pick-up wants a full frame off restoration and as Dan predicted, things get ugly when they peel off the paint. A Heinkel came in with mismatched scooter parts hiding an incredibly rare car - which makes parts almost impossible to find.

programmes.t: Graveyard Carz: Dude, Where's Allysa's Car?
programmes.d: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

Vinnie and team at Muscle Cars of Texas go under the hood of the 69 Malibu. The 63 Z06 factory race car, you have to see what it takes to make this race car look like it came out of the factory. Tagging and bagging time on the 72 Corvette.
A fully disassembled motorcycle is rebuilt from parts to determine if it can run again.

Japanese car culture holds a special place in Sung's heart. He's back exploring the home of drifting to see the coolest mods, and quirkiest characters. Sung finds that a quest for brilliance and excellence makes this the best place to get inspired.
Vinnie and the team are looking at a custom LS3 motor . The 1960 Corvette is getting work done on its brake pads.

Gary wants to restore a 1964 Mercedes 230SL, but his tight budget launches Dan into a headlong battle with a 50-year-old interior and a shattered cam shaft. Al wants to restore his father’s GTO, but FantomWorks discover it’s not the car Al thinks it is.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Cadillac Deville and a 1984 Monte Carlo. The 'caddie' is so full of leaves and rat droppings that it's a health hazard. The Monte Carlo is intended as an anniversary present.
This time, on Muscle Cars of Texas, Vinnie and the team are working on a 63 Z06, 59 Ford Pickup and a 69 Chevy Malibu.
Værterne oplever det stærke fællesskab i motorcykelkulturen gennem træf, events og fælles køreture.

Daniel wants FantomWorks to swap out the V6 of his 1968 Mustang Convertible with the V8 from a donor car. Stacia and Eugenia need Dan’s help to transform their quirky 1962 Citroen 2CV from a ‘problem child’ to a reliable car.
The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.
